list.title: Groups
list.description: Organize people into groups. Groups hold roles, so membership changes are all you need when people move. Groups can be nested.

create.title: Create group
create.description: Add members and roles from the group details after it is created.

delete.title: Delete group
delete.confirm_one: Delete "{{name}}"? Its member ({{count}} direct member; a nested group counts as one) loses the roles the group gives. Deleted groups go to the trash and can be restored.
delete.confirm_other: Delete "{{name}}"? Its members ({{count}} direct members; a nested group counts as one) lose the roles the group gives them. Deleted groups go to the trash and can be restored.
delete.confirmNoTrash_one: Delete "{{name}}"? Its member ({{count}} direct member; a nested group counts as one) loses the roles the group gives.
delete.confirmNoTrash_other: Delete "{{name}}"? Its members ({{count}} direct members; a nested group counts as one) lose the roles the group gives them.

restore.success: Group "{{name}}" restored with its members and roles

detail.title: Group details
detail.rolesHint: Members, including members of nested groups, get these roles. You can only pick roles whose permissions you already have.

role.stale: Someone else just changed this group's roles; your selection is based on outdated data. Saving only sends the changes you made.

member.placeholder: Search for a member to add
member.searchPlaceholder: Search members by name or email
